items.title: CVE-2026-132165 — Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.desc: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.title: CVE-2026-133968 — Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624 — N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
items.desc: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2024-10441 — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
items.desc: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.desc: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.
